protocol.purpose: CGT repository baseline with audited paper settings; known deviations retained
protocol.finetune_epochs_source: repository working choice; not specified by paper
protocol.primary_std: sample standard deviation, ddof=1; paper does not specify ddof

remaining_deviations: upstream augmentation uses fixed probabilities and nondifferentiable edge indices; BCE has no trainable gradient
upstream classification applies softmax before cross entropy
upstream structural filtering/attention have not been fully reimplemented from equations
feature norm interpreted as flattened L2; BCE uses PyTorch endpoint clamp
